args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export skipping the first week when created on the day
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

In `nextRunAt`, the weekly case immediately advances by 7 days without checking whether `next <= from`, unlike the daily case. If a weekly schedule is created before the run hour on its starting day, `next` is already strictly after `from`, but it still gets pushed forward another week. Update the weekly case to check `if (next <= from) next.setUTCDate(next.getUTCDate() + 7);`, or advance by 7 days only if `next <= from` or align it with the daily pattern using day-of-week calculation (or similar check) so a newly created schedule runs on its first eligible day.
